method: Raw columns read through the model; expected values recomputed in Python (validate_model.monthly_expected/qc_expected) with filter propagation re-derived from RELATIONSHIPS; compared to each measure at portfolio, every project, every month, and scorecard category grain. NOW()/UTCNOW() are captured in the same query as the measure, so time-relative measures compare exactly. A SQL-endpoint cross-check re-aggregates the Delta tables independently of Direct Lake for a subset (a SQL SUM(CASE) over 0 matching rows is recorded as BLANK for COUNTROWS measures).
sql_crosscheck_queries: SUM/COUNT/AVG over fct_budgetline, fct_billing, fct_changeorder, fct_directcost, bridge_vendorcostcode, fct_vendorinsurance, fct_qualityitem, fct_milestone, dim_projectcrosswalk, fct_rfisubmittal, fct_qcncr, fct_qcpunch, fct_qcsubmittal, man_qcgate, meta_pipelinerun, measures_anchor; portfolio and one project key
